# LinkedIn Post Template

Reuse this structure for every project ship.

1. **Hook line** — one sentence, no throat-clearing. State the thing you built or the problem it solves.
2. **Context** — 1-2 lines on why (skill gap you're closing, real-world scenario it mirrors).
3. **What it does** — scannable bullets (3-5 max), not paragraphs.
4. **One technical decision, explained** — pick the single most interesting tradeoff from the README's "Why I Built It This Way" section and explain it in plain language for a non-expert LinkedIn audience.
5. **Visual** — screenshot, GIF, or architecture diagram.
6. **Link** — to the GitHub repo/project folder.
7. **Soft CTA** — e.g. "Would love feedback from anyone working in cloud security" — inviting comment, not a hard ask.

Keep total length under ~150 words. LinkedIn rewards posts people can read without clicking "see more."
